statement: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE dev_sean.matt.yt_channel_topic_taxonomy_inferred_edges_20260612 AS WITH train_pairs AS (SELECT * FROM dev_sean.matt.yt_channel_topic_taxonomy_pairwise_estimates_20260612 WHERE split = 'train'), heldout_pairs AS (SELECT * FROM dev_sean.matt.yt_channel_topic_taxonomy_pairwise_estimates_20260612 WHERE split = 'heldout'), candidates AS (SELECT t.antecedent_label AS child_label, t.consequent_label AS parent_label, t.n_antecedent AS train_n_child, t.n_consequent AS train_n_parent, t.n_cooccurring AS train_n_child_parent, t.n_transactions AS train_n_transactions, t.confidence AS train_confidence_child_to_parent, t.reverse_confidence AS train_confidence_parent_to_child, t.lift AS train_lift, t.confidence_asymmetry AS train_confidence_asymmetry, t.confidence_wilson_lower_95 AS train_confidence_wilson_lower_95, t.pct_consequent_before_antecedent AS train_pct_parent_before_child, t.avg_position_delta_consequent_minus_antecedent AS train_avg_parent_minus_child_position, h.n_antecedent AS heldout_n_child, h.n_consequent AS heldout_n_parent, h.n_cooccurring AS heldout_n_child_parent, h.n_transactions AS heldout_n_transactions, h.confidence AS heldout_confidence_child_to_parent, h.reverse_confidence AS heldout_confidence_parent_to_child, h.lift AS heldout_lift, h.confidence_asymmetry AS heldout_confidence_asymmetry, h.confidence_wilson_lower_95 AS heldout_confidence_wilson_lower_95, h.pct_consequent_before_antecedent AS heldout_pct_parent_before_child, h.avg_position_delta_consequent_minus_antecedent AS heldout_avg_parent_minus_child_position FROM train_pairs t LEFT JOIN heldout_pairs h ON t.antecedent_label = h.antecedent_label AND t.consequent_label = h.consequent_label WHERE t.n_antecedent >= 50 AND t.n_consequent > t.n_antecedent AND t.confidence > t.reverse_confidence AND t.lift >= 1.10 AND t.confidence >= 0.75) SELECT *, CASE WHEN train_n_child >= 100 AND train_confidence_child_to_parent >= 0.95 AND train_confidence_wilson_lower_95 >= 0.90 AND train_lift >= 1.25 THEN 'strong_empirical_parent' WHEN train_n_child >= 100 AND train_confidence_child_to_parent >= 0.85 AND train_confidence_wilson_lower_95 >= 0.80 AND train_lift >= 1.15 THEN 'moderate_empirical_parent' ELSE 'weak_or_sparse_association' END AS edge_strength, CASE WHEN heldout_n_child IS NULL OR heldout_n_child = 0 THEN NULL ELSE abs(train_confidence_child_to_parent - heldout_confidence_child_to_parent) END AS abs_confidence_delta_train_heldout FROM candidates
